cases.sentence: В ___ правления царя Валтасара мне, Даниилу, было видение, после того, которое уже являлось мне.
cases.explain: «третий год» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared to me, even to me, Daniel, after that which appeared to me at the first.

cases.explain: «большой рог» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: As I was considering, behold, a male goat came from the west over the surface of the whole earth, and didn’t touch the ground. The goat had a notable horn between his eyes.

cases.sentence: Он пошел к ___, которого я видел стоящим у канала, и в страшной ярости бросился на него.
cases.explain: «двурогому барану» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: He came to the ram that had the two horns, which I saw standing before the river, and ran on him in the fury of his power.

cases.sentence: Козел сильно возвеличился, но на вершине его силы ___ его был сломан, и на его месте выросли четыре видных рога, обращенные к четырем сторонам света .
cases.explain: «большой рог» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The male goat magnified himself exceedingly. When he was strong, the great horn was broken; and instead of it there came up four notable horns toward the four winds of the sky.

cases.sentence: Из одного из них вышел ___, который сперва был мал, но потом очень сильно вырос к югу, и к востоку, и к Прекрасной стране .
cases.explain: «другой рог» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Out of one of them came out a little horn, which grew exceedingly great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the glorious land.

cases.sentence: Из одного из них вышел другой рог, который сперва был мал, но потом очень сильно вырос к югу, и к востоку, и к ___ .
cases.explain: «Прекрасной стране» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Out of one of them came out a little horn, which grew exceedingly great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the glorious land.

cases.sentence: Он вознесся до ___, поверг на землю часть его и часть звезд, и растоптал их.
cases.explain: «небесного воинства» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: It grew great, even to the army of the sky; and it cast down some of the army and of the stars to the ground, and trampled on them.

cases.sentence: Из-за мятежа воинство было отдано ему вместе с ___.
cases.explain: «ежедневной жертвой» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: The army was given over to it together with the continual burnt offering through disobedience. It cast down truth to the ground, and it did its pleasure and prospered.

cases.sentence: И я услышал над каналом Улай ___, зовущий:
cases.explain: «человеческий голос» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: I heard a man’s voice between the banks of the Ulai, which called, and said, “Gabriel, make this man understand the vision.”

cases.sentence: ___, которого ты видел, — это цари Мидии и Персии.
cases.explain: «Двурогий баран» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The ram which you saw, that had the two horns, they are the kings of Media and Persia.

cases.sentence: Косматый козел — это царь Греции, а ___ у него между глаз — это первый царь .
cases.explain: «большой рог» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The rough male goat is the king of Greece. The great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.

cases.sentence: Косматый козел — это царь Греции, а большой рог у него между глаз — это ___ .
cases.explain: «первый царь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The rough male goat is the king of Greece. The great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.

cases.sentence: В конце их царствования, когда мятежники достигнут предела беззаконий, явится ___, искусный в кознях.
cases.explain: «жестокосердный царь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “In the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors have come to the full, a king of fierce face, and understanding dark sentences, will stand up.

cases.sentence: Он станет очень силен, хотя и не своей ___.
cases.explain: «собственной силой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: His power will be mighty, but not by his own power. He will destroy awesomely, and will prosper in what he does. He will destroy the mighty ones and the holy people.

cases.sentence: Его хитрость даст его ___ успех, и он сочтет себя великим.
cases.explain: «коварным планам» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Through his policy he will cause deceit to prosper in his hand. He will magnify himself in his heart, and he will destroy many in their security. He will also stand up against the prince of princes; but he will be broken without hand.

cases.sentence: Потом я встал и начал заниматься ___.
cases.explain: «царскими делами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: I, Daniel, fainted, and was sick for some days. Then I rose up, and did the king’s business. I wondered at the vision, but no one understood it.
